# People

<!-- GENERATED by `make arch-docs` from cmd/arch-docs/areas.go and the code. DO NOT EDIT BY HAND. -->

Who may use Loomarr and how they are reached: sign-in sessions, invitations, password recovery, contact addresses and notifications, plus the encryption of the secrets Loomarr keeps in its database.

One area of the [package map](../package-map.md#start-here).

## Imports from other areas

- **platform** · 4 imports — the identity store accounts and sessions live in, the outbound HTTP client notifications are sent through, and the configured installation secret
- **library** · 1 import — signing a member in with their media-server account

## Packages

- **`people/auth`** · 3 importers · → `library`, `people/contact`, `people/invitation`, `people/recovery`, `store`, `store/identitystore`
  Issues and validates Loomarr sessions (design §11).
- **`people/contact`** · 6 importers
  Owns person contact-address identity and normalization (§11).
- **`people/invitation`** · 7 importers · → `people/contact`
  Owns administrator admission decisions and their bearer grants (§11).
- **`people/notifications`** · 6 importers · → `people/secretprotection`, `platform/httpx`
  Owns channel-neutral notification intents and delivery work (§11).
- **`people/recovery`** · 6 importers
  Owns local-password recovery records and their bearer grants (§11).
- **`people/secretprotection`** · 3 importers · → `platform/config`
  Encrypts database-backed secrets with installation-key-wrapped data keys and supports safe key rotation and replacement.
